name: IRRBB NMD Ladder SOT EVE Check
outcome: Check interest rate risk in the banking book in three independent runs plus a session receipt: map non-maturity deposit balances into a bucketed net repricing gap schedule under a caller-declared behavioral allocation (ART-442), sweep the prescribed US parallel shock ladder over that schedule and name the rung with the lowest delta-EVE (ART-369), then compare that worst delta-EVE against 15 percent of Tier 1 capital as a ladder-based proxy outlier indication (ART-184), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run execution hashes (CRY-05). All balances, allocations, betas, gaps, and capital are caller-supplied inputs; each run is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. This chain is an analytical check and a comparison against a threshold under a stated ladder.
